decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal">The proposed first floor rear extension by reason of its
excessive width and depth would result in a cramped, disproportionate and
incongruous addition to the dwellinghouse which would fail to respect the
proportions of the host property. The proposed development would result in a
detrimental impact to the character and appearance of the host property and the wider area, thereby resulting in a detrimental impact to
the visual amenities of the area. The proposal is therefore contrary to the
high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework
(2024), D3.D(1) and D3.D(11) of The London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1.B of
the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1 of the Harrow Development
Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the adopted Supplementary Planning
Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">The proposed first floor rear extension by reason of its
size and siting would result in an overly prominent and overbearing development
which results in a detrimental impact to the visual and residential amenities
of Nos. 88 and 92&nbsp;The Heights due to an adverse&nbsp;loss of outlook,
sunlight and a heightened sense of enclosure. The proposal is therefore
contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy
Framework (2024), Policy D3.D(7) of The London Plan (2021), Policy DMC of the
Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the adopted
Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).<o:p></o:p></p>
description: Single and two storey rear extension (Demolition of rear extension)
